scope: Steps 1-4: baseline backup, measurement, independent full apartment 14, resource lifecycle and return state. No geometry redesign.
environment: Local Vite development build, Edge headless, 1280x800, hardwareConcurrency=4, reduced motion. One recorded baseline and final run; not a universal loading-time or FPS guarantee.
notes: Texture RGBA values are estimates, not measured GPU memory.
Triangle counts are per rendered frame at the same Living destination.
The complete apartment and balcony remain 3D; distant exterior uses a captured panorama with approximate night tint.
Exterior rebuilds on return instead of retaining two GPU scenes.
Three.js internal texture counters can remain after disposal; old WebGL contexts were verified lost, old geometry counters zero, and only one canvas active.
Drone routes spanning exterior and isolated apartment require separate recordings.
